# Official macpoker SDK

An unchanged copy of the organiser's SDK download on 9 October 2026. Its Python files match the SDK used in this repository's fresh-install checks.

- Source: [official SDK download](https://poker.monashcoding.com/dl/macpoker-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl)
- SHA-256: `75904f0d557fff23ab25d8257cac9cd2e32742749c3e8fbd1d2e2fe5bb5e6f4b`
- Package metadata declares `License: MIT`. The original wheel contains no separate licence file.

The copy keeps installation available if the competition website closes. From the repository root, run `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt`. NumPy is installed separately from PyPI.
